data.gender_notes: Mukairiman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic words 'mukarim' meaning 'sacred' and 'aman' meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to be protectors and guardians in their communities. The name Mukairiman carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mukairiman usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
